timelineMinutes.why: Length of the generated weather timeline: a race plus a two-hour limit with margin.

cloudStart.why: Cloud cover at the start of a dry race is drawn from this range; rain needs cloud, so a rain episode first builds cover towards 1.

cloudDriftPerHourSd.why: Random walk of cloud cover per hour: enough for sun to come and go during a race.

trackTempCloudDropC.why: How much cooler the asphalt runs under full cloud than in full sun (its offset over the air shrinks by this much).

trackTempLagMinutes.why: Time constant for asphalt temperature to follow a change in cloud — 'changes within 15 minutes' (plan 5.4).

airTempDriftPerHourSd.why: Random walk of air temperature per hour, °C.

humidity.why: Humidity %: drawn from the range, raised by cloud cover, near saturation while it rains.

windDriftPerHourSd.why: Random walk of wind per hour: direction can swing enough to change which sectors gain and lose (plan 5.4).

rain.why: A rain episode: starts somewhere in the race window, lasts 12–70 minutes, from drizzle (0.15) to a downpour (1), and reaches each following sector 2–9 minutes after the previous one — rain arrives by sectors (plan 5.4).

rainShape.why: Shape of a rain episode: it fades in and out over 3 minutes per sector; cloud builds from 20 minutes before and clears 10 minutes after, closing 10% of the gap each minute; rain cools the air 0.03 °C per minute; a race that starts in rain starts at 80% of the intensity as wetness; a sector dries only when rain there is below 0.02.

wettingPerMinute.why: Wetness gained per minute at rain intensity 1: a downpour floods a sector in ~15 minutes, drizzle only dampens it.

drying.why: Wetness lost per minute once rain stops: a base rate plus warm asphalt, wind and cars clearing a line; a medium-wet track dries to slick conditions in ~20–30 minutes.

powerLossPerDegAbove25.why: Share of lap time lost per °C of air above 25 °C, scaled by the track's power sensitivity: hot, thin air costs engines power.

powerLossPerHumidityPointAbove50.why: Share of lap time lost per humidity point above 50%, scaled by power sensitivity: humid air burns less efficiently.

windStraightSPerKph.why: Seconds per kph of tail (−) or head (+) wind over a whole sector made of straights: a 20 kph headwind down a long straight costs ~0.08 s.

crosswindCornerSPerKph.why: Seconds per kph of crosswind through a sector made of corners: the car loses stability and confidence (plan 5.4).

wetSlowdownFraction.why: Share of lap time a fully wet track costs even on the right tyre: less grip, spray, caution.

evolution.why: Track grip 0..1: rubbered to 0.85 by Sunday, +0.00012 per car-lap (≈0.13 over a race), washed away by rain. A fully green track costs 3% × the track's evolution factor — 1.5–2.5 s on street circuits (plan 5.4).
